description: What needs the account’s attention (needs an API key): new videos from its follows (kind "video", with the video’s url to pass to share_video, edit_video or get_transcript, and, when its follow finds moments, the proposed parts with start and end seconds to pass along), follows that reached their end ("ended") and follows whose feed can’t be read ("failing"). Mark rows done or dismissed with update_inbox_item once handled.
name: check_inbox
title: Check the inbox
